query: Who are the leading vendors in AI storage / AI data-center storage worldwide and in China?
response:
As of 2024, the AI storage and AI-optimized data center storage market is rapidly evolving, driven by the explosive growth of large language models (LLMs), generative AI workloads, and high-performance computing (HPC) requirements. These workloads demand ultra-low-latency, high-throughput, scalable, and intelligent storage—especially for training (massive sequential I/O) and inference (highly parallel, random-access patterns). Below is a breakdown of leading vendors globally and in China, categorized by strategic positioning and technical differentiation:
